event_chain.summary: Permissions regression re-exposes public projects' AI chat histories

summary: In February 2026 a backend permissions update at Lovable, the Swedish AI app-building platform, accidentally re-enabled a broken object level authorization (BOLA) flaw that let anyone read the AI chat histories of public free-tier projects, which Lovable had fixed in December 2025. The chats could contain credentials, API keys, business logic and personal data. The flaw was reported through Lovable's bug bounty program and became public in April 2026; Lovable initially called it intended behavior, patched new projects first, and later apologized.
